text:
oncall-bot: Pager: 2xx alerts — inference pool eu-west-2 reporting node NotReady + kubelet restarts. Severity: P1. @pager oncall: please ack.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2533333. Owner: alex.
alex: acked. seeing spikes in 5xx from the inference API and pods restarting in the infer namespace. digging.

jordan: I see a pattern of kubelet crashes on those nodes around the same time as CUDA driver faults in /var/log/messages. possible driver hang -> kubelet restart -> node NotReady.

maya: @alex can you confirm whether Dedicated/Private routing is diverting traffic? need to protect customers.
alex: routing is still hitting eu-west-2. we have smart-routing fallbacks but they haven't fully kicked in because some model variants match only on latency policy.

lee: grabbing k8s facts: `kubectl get nodes -o wide | grep eu-west-2` shows 4 nodes NotReady, 2 Ready. `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide` shows ~30 CrashLoopBackOff / OOMKilled on gpu-backed pods.

alex: paste logs from kubelet on node eu-west-2-node-12: ```Mar 15 14:12:03 kernel: NVRM: GPU has fallen off the bus. Mar 15 14:12:04 kubelet[1234]: runtime/cgo: pthread_create failed: Resource temporarily unavailable Mar 15 14:12:06 kubelet[1234]: fatal error: runtime: out of memory```

jordan: yep that looks like a driver/GPU fault leading to container OOMs and then kubelet process instability. Could be a bad driver pushed in last image or a kernel regression.

deploy-bot: Noted: no infra deploys in region in last 3 hours.

maya: immediate mitigations: (1) cordon affected nodes, (2) scale up fallback capacity in us-west-1/us-east-1, (3) enable model-variant fallback to CPU-backed low-latency pool for critical customers, (4) alert support to throttle new sessions.
alex: executing step 1: `kubectl cordon eu-west-2-node-11 eu-west-2-node-12 eu-west-2-node-13 eu-west-2-node-14` — done.

lee: scaling clusterpool: `terraform apply` queued — starting 3 extra g4 nodes in us-west-1 for spillover. ETA ~4m.

jordan: meanwhile we should patch the node driver: I recommend reboot + an older NVIDIA driver rollback once nodes are drained. but that's after traffic is stabilized.

maya: customer impact: support dashboard shows ~4% of requests failing with 500 over the last 12m, latency p95 up from 60ms->420ms for affected model. affected customers: two mid-market clusters with dedicated routing, we should notify them.

alex: posting CC to SRE-oncall and Account Execs. crafting short status: "We are mitigating a GPU driver-related node instability in eu-west-2 affecting ~4% requests; we've cordoned nodes and are scaling cross-region. ETA for stabilization 15-25m."

jordan: evidence: `dmesg | grep NVRM` returns repeated "GPU has fallen off the bus" on 3 nodes. also container logs show `CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_INSTRUCTION` followed by OOMKilled.

lee: executed drain on two most unstable nodes: `kubectl drain eu-west-2-node-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` — pods moved to other nodes; some evicted to Pending due to GPU resource shortage.

maya: enabling auto-fallback: flipped routing flag in console to bias to cpu-fallback for customers with SLA < standard. test traffic shows successful fallback for chat endpoints.

alex: metrics: error budget burn plateauing after cordon + scaling - error rate dropping from 4% -> 1.2% in 7m. p95 latency trending down.

jordan: note for postmortem: check recent kernel/driver updates, GPU temperature trends, and any cron jobs that push heavy memory work to nodes at 14:00 UTC. Also validate node-level OOM killer configs and kubelet memory limits.

deploy-bot: Reminder: create postmortem ticket INC-2533333-PM and tag eng-runtime + eng-ml.

lee: after a rolling reboot of the 4 nodes and driver rollback to NVIDIA 525.105 (previous stable), kubelet stayed stable for 12m. bringing nodes back: `kubectl uncordon ...`

maya: sanity check: canary traffic to restored nodes looks OK. runbook step completed: node reboot + driver rollback.

alex: handing off to maya for monitoring and post-incident ops. Maya, you own the follow-up and postmortem.
maya: taking it. will run through remediation checklist, notify affected customers with incident summary, and schedule deeper infra investigation tomorrow.

alex: closing slack thread for the active pager. will leave channel open for questions. :white_check_mark:
maya: creating postmortem now and will ping when draft is ready. thanks all for quick coordination :heart: 

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2533333 updated: status -> monitoring.
